```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

if (!requireNamespace("sysgenAnalysis", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::install_github("AttieLab-Systems-Genetics/sysgenAnalysis")
}
library(sysgenAnalysis)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
```

## Configuration

```{r config}
# NOTE: If rendering from the package library, use 'quarto render ... --execute-dir .'
# to ensure relative paths below resolve to your project directory.
base_research_dir <- research_dir()
base_out <- file.path(dirname(base_research_dir), "Projects2/Antigravity/SNP_conservation")
```

## Load Results from CSVs

```{r load-results}
results <- sysgenAnalysis::read_conserve_analysis(base_out)
```

## Results Summary

### Overall Statistics

```{r summary}
summary(results)
```

### Global Hotspots

Top variants found across multiple trait classes.

```{r hotspots-table}
knitr::kable(head(results$hotspots[, .(variant_id, gene_symbol, trait_class_count, trait_classes, max_priority)], 20))
```

## Visualizations

### Global Hotspot Manhattan Plot

```{r plot-global, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
plot(results)
```

### Trait-Specific Manhattan Plots {.tabset}

```{r plot-traits, results='asis', fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
for (t_name in names(results$all_results)) {
  cat("\n#### ", t_name, "\n")
  p <- plot(results, trait_name = t_name)
  print(p)
  cat("\n")
}
```
